(defn fraud-country-stats []
  (loop [c nil a {}]
    (let [p (dabstep.payments/read-page c ["ip_country" "eur_amount" "has_fraudulent_dispute"])
          r (:rows p)
          a2 (reduce (fn [m row]
                       (let [k (nth row 0) v (nth row 1) f (nth row 2) old (get m k [0 0]) amt (if v v 0)]
                         (if k
                           (assoc m k [(+ (nth old 0) (if f amt 0)) (+ (nth old 1) amt)])
                           m)))
                     a r)]
      (if (:next_cursor p)
        (recur (:next_cursor p) a2)
        a2))))
nil
